description: 2026-10-17 cost mitigation arm for the web_fetch restoration (docs/adr/0018-source-urls-in-initial-prompt.md D8). Identical to haiku-5-5-source-urls in every declared dimension -- model claude-haiku-5-5, effort high, system prompt, skill pin, and the same task-prompt.md with the generated curated-source-URL block appended -- except that agent.json's toolset sets the web_fetch setting max_content_tokens to 8000. The first source-URL eval repetition fetched successfully (27 fetches, 19 of them curated sources, 0 rejections) but nearly doubled the cost per run ($1.35 vs $0.71 Platform list cost), because a large RSS feed arrives in context in full (~100K characters each). This arm measures whether capping fetched page content recovers that cost without losing the restored source coverage. Equality-except-the-web_fetch-config against haiku-5-5-source-urls is enforced by tests/test_source_urls_capped_candidate.py; the block's currency vs. the skill's sources.md by deploy/managed-agent/tests/test_source_url_block_drift.py. Content generation only; holds no AWS/delivery role; never fans out, never synthesizes audio.
schedule_intent: none -- eval candidate only; never scheduled. Applying max_content_tokens to production is a separate, owner-gated decision that would cost a new agent version (ADR-0018 D8).
